Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for all molecules mentioned in document CHEMBL4513141. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and inner join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical_smiles. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513141'. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
